children: ECA Marcellus Trust I announced a distribution of $0.021 per unit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The distribution is expected to be paid by November 30 to unitholders of record on November 23. The Trustee will withhold approximately $90,000 for the Trust’s cash reserve.
Quarterly distribution: $0.021 per unit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
The Trustee elected to withhold approximately $90,000 from the quarter’s distribution to build the cash reserve.

The Trust owns royalty interests in natural gas properties in Pennsylvania’s Marcellus Shale, and receives a portion of proceeds from production sales attributable to Greylock Energy and certain subsidiaries.
Distribution amounts fluctuate based on production proceeds, natural gas prices, and Trust administrative expenses.
Commodity-price volatility affects proceeds available to the Trust; low natural gas prices can reduce distributions and could result in periods with no distribution.
